notes.title: New Multiball
notes.notes:
Hello pinball fans,

In today's update I added new skins for multiball balls. A tip, you increase the multiball number when the ball travels 10 times in the countdown way.

I also modified the sounds of the right and left ramps, it will not play the sound every time the ball goes through it, just sometimes.

And finally, I fixed a bug that stopped the match, sorry if anyone has experienced this.

Thx for playing :)

notes.title: Ranking expanded and others
notes.notes:
Hello people,

In this update I modified the following items:
- expanded the ranking view on the home screen to 10 positions
- fixed a bug in the positioning of messages in windowed mode
- added a little bounce to the ball, which increased the sense of realism (and the difficulty)

let me know what you think of the changes, especially the physics of the ball

thanks for playing

Alexandre Laredo
